back.es: to deceive, to fool; (of a partner) to cheat on, to be unfaithful to
back.example: Are you cheating on me with another woman?

note: The hint "a partner" is needed to keep "cheat on" apart from cheating on a test (hacer trampa, copiar), and "con otra" literally means "with another woman", so the English could say that instead of "someone else".
